title: The Weight of Words
provenance: Original catalogue work by Mary Adesakin Damilola.

description.en: This art piece depicts a man immersed in a newspaper, seated in his private library. The work reflects on media, solitude, and the psychological weight of staying informed in an age of constant updates.
description.yo: Ise yi n wo bi iroyin, ipalemo inu, ati iwuwo ero se n kan eniyan.
description.fr: Cette oeuvre reflechit au poids psychologique de l'information, de la solitude et des medias.

title: Maze of Uncertainty
provenance: Original catalogue work by Mary Adesakin Damilola.

description.en: Maze of Uncertainty was created as a reflection on the moments in life when the path ahead feels unclear. Through the woman's contemplative gaze and the shifting colors of the background, I explore how vulnerability and strength coexist in times of doubt.
description.yo: Maze of Uncertainty n soro nipa akoko ti ona iwaju ko ye wa, ati bi ailera ati agbara se le wa papo.
description.fr: Maze of Uncertainty explore les moments ou le chemin semble incertain, entre vulnerabilite, force et resilience.

title: Loud Silence
provenance: Featured at the Life In My City Art Festival Ondo Regional Zone.

description.en: Loud Silence captures a frozen scream, a suspended moment of agony, a cry for breath, and a plea for justice. The loose vertical threads split the face and conceal the voice.
description.yo: Loud Silence n mu igbe inu, irora, ati ipe fun ododo han pelu okun.
description.fr: Loud Silence saisit un cri suspendu, une douleur retenue et une demande de justice.

title: Visible Within
provenance: Original catalogue work by Mary Adesakin Damilola.

description.en: This work depicts the eye as the window of the soul, using thread to materialize emotional release. Turquoise strands transform tears into a symbol of healing rather than fragility.
description.yo: Ise yi lo oju gege bi ferese okan, pelu okun ti o so omije di ami iwosan.
description.fr: Cette oeuvre presente l'oeil comme une fenetre de l'ame, transformant les larmes en signe de guerison.

title: Hands That Won't Let Go
medium: Mixed Media (Thread and Acrylic on Canvas)
provenance: Original portfolio work by Mary Adesakin Damilola.

description.en: A violinist held by multiple hands, tracing the fragile line between guidance, inherited pressure, and the desire for self-expression.
description.yo: Olorin violin ti owo pupo di mu, laarin itoju, ipa, ati ife lati so ara re han.
description.fr: Une violoniste tenue par plusieurs mains, entre guidance, pression heritee et expression de soi.

title: The Ife Muse
provenance: Original portfolio work by Mary Adesakin Damilola.

description.en: Inspired by ancient Ife bronze heads, this portrait reconnects facial markings, memory, and Yoruba heritage through thread.
description.yo: Ise yi ni imisi lati ori idẹ Ife atijo, ti o so iranti ati asa Yoruba po pelu okun.
description.fr: Inspiree par les tetes de bronze d'Ife, cette oeuvre relie memoire, marques faciales et heritage yoruba.

title: Beauty in Becoming
provenance: Original portfolio work by Mary Adesakin Damilola.

description.en: A quiet portrait of identity, vulnerability, and growth, where thread lines and a rose hold space for resilience and renewal.
description.yo: Aworan idakẹjẹ nipa idanimọ, idagbasoke, ati agbara lati tun ara se.
description.fr: Un portrait calme sur l'identite, la vulnerabilite, la croissance et le renouveau.

title: The Calm Before Clarity
medium: Mixed Media (Thread and Acrylic on Canvas)
provenance: Original portfolio work by Mary Adesakin Damilola.

description.en: A contemplative gaze held within shifting colour, approaching uncertainty as a space for reflection, resilience, and possibility.
description.yo: Wiwo inu ninu awon awo ti n yipada, n ri aidaniloju gege bi aaye ero ati ireti.
description.fr: Un regard contemplatif dans des couleurs mouvantes, ou l'incertitude devient espace de resilience.

title: Rare Like a Blue Rose
medium: Mixed Media (Thread and Acrylic on Canvas)
provenance: Original portfolio work by Mary Adesakin Damilola.

description.en: A vivid affirmation of self-possession: finding light within and letting it shine fully, whatever the odds.
description.yo: Ifihan ti igboya ati imole inu, pelu agbara lati tan ni kikun.
description.fr: Une affirmation vive de la possession de soi et de la lumiere interieure.

title: The Weight
provenance: Sold catalogue work by Mary Adesakin Damilola.

description.en: Sold original work from Mary Adesakin's 2024 catalogue.
description.yo: Ise atilẹba ti ta lati katalogi Mary Adesakin 2024.
description.fr: Oeuvre originale vendue du catalogue 2024 de Mary Adesakin.

title: In Her Prime
provenance: Sold catalogue work by Mary Adesakin Damilola.

description.en: Sold original work from Mary Adesakin's 2024 catalogue, centered on women's education, service, and the fullness of feminine becoming.
description.yo: Ise ti ta, nipa eko obinrin, ise iranlowo, ati idagbasoke obinrin.
description.fr: Oeuvre vendue sur l'education des femmes, le service et le devenir feminin.

title: Stitched in Time
provenance: Sold catalogue work by Mary Adesakin Damilola.

description.en: Inspired by the Olojo Festival in Ile-Ife, this work reimagines the spiritual and ancestral resonance of bata drum traditions.
description.yo: Imisi lati Odun Olojo ni Ile-Ife, ti o tun ro ohun bata ati iranti awon baba nla.
description.fr: Inspiree par le festival Olojo d'Ile-Ife, cette oeuvre reimagine les traditions du tambour bata.
